title: VSCode Snippets Schema
description: User Snippets configuration schema for FoxVim & VSCode

prefix.description: The trigger prefix / word that expands the snippet in autocompletion.

body.description: The snippet body line(s). Supports tabstops (${1:default}, ${2}), variables ($TM_FILENAME, $CURRENT_YEAR), and exit point (${0}).

description.description: Human-readable description shown in completion details.

scope.description: Optional language identifiers where this snippet applies (e.g., 'lua', 'typescript').

$schema.description: URI of the JSON schema for validation.
